objective: Turn the current matter-first Nocturnal candidate into one truthful canonical, demonstrable and conversion-ready system without reopening product design.

verified_topology.hosted_ci: FAILS_BEFORE_ANY_STEP_EXECUTES; do not treat this as product-test evidence

closure_sequence: integrate RC2 into main with preserved ancestry
rebase or integrate V3 onto the resulting canonical head
run exact-head product, interface, visual, scale, container and release-scrub certification
freeze one real bounded demonstration covering story, change, chronology, sources, evidence, research and historical compare
perform desktop and mobile visual acceptance
publish the evaluator walkthrough and exact-head certification receipt
mark RC1 superseded while preserving history
freeze the Now / Read / Research interface unless a real pilot exposes a defect

conversion_after_closure.selection_gate: choose the partner whose real case best matches the frozen demo and whose pilot can measure workflow delta without requiring private-person surveillance
conversion_after_closure.external_send_gate: canonical demo plus exact-head certification plus human review of the final outreach

allowed_claims: current V3 candidate exposes Now, Read and Research surfaces
correction and supersession-aware chronology and evidence views
forbidden_claims: external analyst adoption or measured workflow improvement
